description: This file defines the ShiftRequest document class and related validation and processing methods for handling employee shift requests in an ERP system.

classes.name: OverlapError
classes.description: Custom validation error class for shift request overlaps.

classes.name: ShiftRequest
classes.description: Document class representing an employee's shift request with validation and workflow methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the shift request before saving.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Shares the document with the approver upon update.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Creates a shift assignment if approved, and enforces status rules.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Cancels related shift assignments when the request is canceled.

methods.name: validate_default_shift
methods.description: Ensures the requested shift is not the employee's default shift.

methods.name: validate_approver
methods.description: Checks if the approver is authorized based on department and approver list.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Validates that the end date is not before the start date.

methods.name: validate_shift_request_overlap_dates
methods.description: Checks for overlapping shift requests for the same employee.

methods.name: throw_overlap_error
methods.description: Raises an error if overlapping shift requests are found.
